name: Nise Kyoushi ~Seikatsu Shidou ADV~
source:
One day, Masato receives a misdelivered parcel. But he gets interested in it and opens it. There are some medicines, an envelope, an ID card, and a password inside. He opens the envelope and finds a paper. It says, "The right to work at Hakuyo High School".
"What? Can I really work at Hakuyo High School? I see. Girls, I'll severely discipline you!"

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
某天，正人收到了一个投递错误的包裹，好奇心驱使下他私自拆开了封口，只见里面装着几瓶药剂、一个信封、一张身份胸卡以及一串密码。他拆开信封抽出一张纸条，上面赫然写着：“柏阳高中任职资格证”。
“什么？我当真能去柏阳高中当老师？原来如此……女学生们，就等着接受我严厉的‘性活指导’吧！”

[摘自ErogeShop]
